# PyAutoCTI Visualization Gallery

<!-- Generated by gallery/gallery_build.py from scripts/<domain>/images/. Do not edit by hand: rerun `bash gallery/gallery_run.sh --all`. -->

Rendered with PyAutoCTI `2024.11.13.2` · 135 figures.

Every figure below is what `VisualizerDataset1D` / `VisualizerImagingCI` write to a model-fit's `image/` folder (one analysis and the combined multi-dataset pass), plus the `autocti.plot` figures the Visualizer never writes under `direct/`, rendered on this repo's datasets with the true CTI model. See [README.md](README.md) for how to improve one.
